title: A picture dragged in from the Finder is named after the file
goal: A file dragged into the picture from the Finder becomes a layer called Pasted Image, whatever the file was called. Once a screen holds three of them the layers list is three rows of the same word. Name the layer after the file instead.
notes: EditorState.addImageLayerOrOpen -> pasteImage(_:at:) builds Layer(name: "Pasted Image"). Pass the URL's deletingPathExtension().lastPathComponent through as the name; freshLayerName-style de-duping already exists for groups (freshGroupName).
acceptance: A file dragged in from the Finder becomes a layer named after the file, without its extension
An image pasted from the clipboard, which has no file behind it, is still called Pasted Image
Two files with the same name dropped into one document get distinguishable layer names

log.note: superseded: the naming half shipped hours after this was filed (PlacedImageNaming, commit 572b6b1), so two of its three acceptance items are already true. The one gap left, two copies of a file giving two identical rows, is filed as two-pictures-with-the-same-name-get-told-apart-i
